reference_method: LLM-assisted draft, user review and explicit approval per question; not independent human ratings

selection_design.execution: manual web chat; imported scores; exact model IDs, API access, cost, latency and session/tool logs unverified

selection_basis: Gemini lowest aggregate MCQ and G-Eval MAE. GPT cross-provider choice prioritizes quality/error sensitivity; Claude lower MCQ MAE than GPT. Limited sample and ceiling effect; not general performance proof.
next_gate: L05 독립 인간 채점·선정/검증 자료와 추가 비교 집계(미실행 사유 포함)를 확인하고 C05 실제 수동 프롬프트·모델 설정·루브릭·선정 근거·해시를 최종 답변 열람 전에 동결함. DSPy는 11/28 회의에서 제외 확정. C03/L04 실제 API·접근통제·형식 및 실제 개발 활용 검토 미통과 시 L06 실행 금지. L07은 L06의 동일 저장 응답만 사용함.
security: Public aggregate only. Raw scoring, question/gold packets and internal prompts withheld.
team_sharing_policy: Team-internal group sharing for human review; no final item/gold use in candidate development or judge optimization; no public release without separate approval. Actual judging environment remains separate.
